"""Recorded RoboLab carton recycling episode; observations use only cameras and robot proprioception."""
import sys, json, pathlib, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
r = None
latest = None
counter = 0

def initialize():
    global r
    r = Robot()
    pathlib.Path('/app/output/spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2))
    print('READY', json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)

def recover():
    status = r.wait_ready()
    print('RECOVERED', json.dumps(status), flush=True)
    return status

def save_result(res, name):
    global latest, counter
    latest = res
    counter += 1
    path = f'/app/runs/{counter:03d}_{name}'
    res.save(path)
    pathlib.Path('/app/output/latest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'path': path, 'meta': res.meta}, indent=2))
    print('RESULT', path, json.dumps({k:v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k not in ('cameras',)}), flush=True)
    return res

def observe(name='observe', depth=True, seconds=0):
    return save_result(r.get_obs(depth=depth, seconds=seconds, video='none'), name)

def move(poses, name='move', dt=0.2):
    return save_result(r.submit('ee_pose', poses, dt=dt, video='none', depth=True, note=name), name)

def joints(rows, name='joints', dt=0.2):
    return save_result(r.submit('joint_position', rows, dt=dt, video='none', depth=True, note=name), name)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    initialize()
    observe('initial')
